## Judgment

pi-durable moves from 4685dcd to 87a9d6d (decision D-38, child work trees).

- A subagent or team member that can write gets its own git work tree, branched from the parent's branch, under the workspaces root. The parent integrates it with the new `worktree` tool; only a person lands on a base (W2 unchanged).
- New option `workspaces.maxChildren` (default 6) sets `PIDURABLE_WORKSPACES_MAX_CHILDREN` on every instance; nothing else in the unit changes.
- Gates before this bump: tsc, node suite 1963 (one timing test flaked under load and passed alone), Playwright 469 passed on desktop and phone, check-docs and check-style, `nix flake check` with zero eval warnings, and `nix build` of the module-unit and browser checks.
- An independent code review found six issues (none lost committed work); all are fixed with regression tests (test/e2e/review-d38.test.ts).

Risk: low for existing sessions: the default of new subagents changes only for sessions in a work tree. Rollback: revert this lock bump.
